lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: King-jack, early position. Raised, got three-bet, called. Flopped a jack. He had kings.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Then the flop didn't beat you. The first decision did. Everything after that was a story you told yourself.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Fold the junk. It isn't advice. It's arithmetic.
